component.name: PyNextCloud Sync
component.summary: Lightweight Nextcloud file synchronization for Linux

description.p: PyNextCloud Sync keeps one complete physical local mirror of a Nextcloud account synchronized through the official nextcloudcmd engine.
It adds GNOME integration, filesystem monitoring, server push notifications, safety intervals, secure account setup, exclusions, and logs.

ul.li: Added the native GNOME Keyring unlock prompt needed after biometric desktop login.
Kept canceled unlocks separate from invalid Nextcloud credentials and prevented repeated automatic prompts.
Resumed file synchronization and notify_push together after an explicit successful unlock.
Made interactive Debian upgrades gracefully stop and restart a running application.
Published corrected project, issue, and changelog links under the canonical ehstbr repository.
Bumped the package version so systems with 0.1.8 installed apply the corrected metadata and application files.
Added native Files sidebar and desktop shortcuts for the synchronized folder.
Added a branded folder icon and independent settings for the three integrations.
Files bookmark changes now remain consistent with the Settings window.
Settings now opens as an independent window directly from the tray.
The main window remains closed and unallocated when opening Settings.
Fixed opening Settings from the tray while the main window is closed.
Made the main interface lazy and releasable to reduce background memory.
Bounded command output, log display, activity history, and login polling.
Avoided unnecessary inotify and push reconfiguration.
Added click-to-expand activity messages and right-click copy support.
Bundled translations and fixed Brazilian Portuguese locale detection.
Completed the Brazilian Portuguese application catalog.
Made the tray icon, title, tooltip, and attention state follow synchronization state changes live.
Added compatible StatusNotifierItem and D-Bus property change notifications.
Fixed the branded tray icon on GNOME AppIndicator hosts.
Added correct icon theme metadata, an absolute SVG path, and pixel fallbacks.
Responsive compact main window and collapsible activity view.
Reliable tray menu with a branded icon fallback.
Configurable daily log files and expanded About information.
Fixes for D-Bus menu variants, literal log text, and numeric formatting.
